title: Times Beach: contamination, flood, relocation and cleanup
subtitle: Selected stages documented in the U.S. EPA Region 7 retrospective

source.title: A Town, a Flood, and Superfund: Looking Back at the Times Beach Disaster Nearly 40 Years Later

events.title: Contaminated mixture used for dust suppression
events.detail: EPA says a dioxin and waste-oil mixture was sprayed at more than 25 Missouri locations, including Times Beach.

events.title: Town receives first contamination warning
events.detail: EPA identifies this as Times Beach's first news of possible dioxin contamination and records soil sampling.

events.title: Flood, evacuation and no-return recommendation
events.detail: Record Meramec River flooding forced evacuation; CDC and EPA recommended that the town not be reinhabited.

events.title: Federal and state buyout announced
events.detail: EPA announced a Superfund-funded buyout covering 800 residential properties and 30 businesses after recommending permanent relocation for more than 2,000 residents.

events.title: Consent decree assigns cleanup work
events.detail: The decree allocated excavation, transport, demolition, incinerator construction, operation and long-term management responsibilities.

events.title: Incineration and cleanup completion
events.detail: EPA records the temporary incinerator in 1996 and marks cleanup completed in 1997; materials came from Times Beach and other eastern Missouri sites.

events.title: State park opens; site later leaves NPL
events.detail: Route 66 State Park opened on the former town site in 1999. EPA deleted Times Beach from the National Priorities List in 2001.

events.title: EPA conducts follow-up park sampling
events.detail: EPA Region 7 reports that sampling confirmed no significant health risk for workers or visitors at Route 66 State Park.

caption: Selected documented stages, arranged in reading order. Equal spacing and box size do not encode elapsed time, contamination level, risk, cost, causal weight or policy effectiveness. The diagram is an EPA-sourced chronology, not a complete community history or independent health assessment. AI source review is not human editorial approval.
